scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the official Kaito origin stories (December 2021) and three Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty side stories (February 2022) tagged to the NEO arc in batch 7. One claim per page; not an exhaustive reading. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: kaito

But Kaito hadn't joined the Hyozan Reckoners for the money.

claims.subject: chishiro

quotes.quote: When he'd arrived in Far Corner, Chishiro had thought the worshippers foolish.

claims.subject: katsumasa

quotes.quote: As Katsumasa led her through a maze of passages, Kotori's skin crackled with exhilaration.
Across Otawara, his name was spoken with hushed reverence: Katsumasa, the Animator, puppeteer of the mechs, engineer of the future.

claims.summary: Katsumasa, the Animator, leads Kotori into his workshop.
claims.limitation: A guiding role is shown; a formal mentorship is inferred.

claims.subject: heiko

quotes.quote: Norika puts every ounce of authority she can muster into her ten-year-old voice and, as always, it has zero effect on her cousin.

And though Norika understands well her responsibilities as the elder cousin, the eldest daughter of the Yamazaki household, the more Heiko pesters her, the more she has to admit—she wants to see the merge, too.

claims.summary: Norika and Heiko are cousins; Norika is the elder.
